asks.title: Open the cockpit on your phone with the LAN URL (not 'localhost')
asks.why: 'localhost' on your phone points at the phone itself, so the window was dark there by design. The server now prints the real address your phone can reach (it changes with the network, so I always show the current one).
asks.how: On the cockpit, top-right shows 'open on phone: http://<ip>:8788'. Same address is in ops/cockpit/access.txt. Bookmark it. Your phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the Mac.
asks.done_when: The cockpit loads on your phone and the top-left says 'window LIVE'.
asks.priority: low — nice to have, not blocking

asks.title: (Optional, one-time) Grant Full Disk Access so the cockpit also survives a full reboot
asks.why: It already self-heals from crashes, sleep, and my session ending. The ONLY gap is a full Mac restart, because macOS blocks background launch agents from reading the repo in ~/Documents unless you allow it once. Skip this if you rarely reboot.
asks.how: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Full Disk Access -> '+' -> press Cmd+Shift+G, type /usr/bin/python3, add it, toggle ON. Then I run scripts/install_cockpit_agent.sh once and launchd takes over reboot-survival. Until then the userland supervisor covers everything except reboot.
asks.done_when: After a reboot, the cockpit answers before you open any terminal.
